_comment: broca-machina OLLAMA example — talk to a local model. The command transport runs brain.sh, which sends $VOICE_TRANSCRIPT to Ollama and prints the reply. Replace every /ABS/PATH/TO/... with real absolute paths, set discord.allowedUserId to YOUR Discord user ID, and fill in the guild/channel IDs. Model/backend are set by env vars read inside brain.sh (see README.md).
